capabilities: animate a color-rotating border around hovered file tree items
highlight the active file tree item with a rotating border overlay
draw borders on an independent overlay layer to avoid overflow clipping
disambiguation: Not a file-selection or search tool; it only adds animated border-color decoration to items in the file tree.
extras: README is written largely as a project blueprint for AI developers; it references separate files (AGENTS.md, MANUAL.md, SPEC.md) without including their content, so user-facing documentation is not present. The manifest notes the plugin has not been reviewed by Obsidian staff.
problem: The file tree marks active and hovered items only with static highlighting, offering no strong animated visual cue for the current selection.
summary: File-tree visual enhancement that animates a color-rotating border overlay around hovered and active file explorer items.
